verdict.rationale: Kit documents some deletion and retention behavior. The API can permanently delete draft or scheduled broadcasts (204 on success), and Kit publishes a data-retention page saying email stats are returned for the last 5 years. That window is a vendor-set policy, though, not a retention setting the user controls, so it adds little beyond transparency. Missing for 10: user-configurable retention periods, deletion of subscriber/personal data (e.g., GDPR erasure), account-level data deletion or export controls, deletion of sent broadcasts and other objects, and any independent corroboration.
